title: The fixed-scalar inverse direct-image comparison is normalized by complex-level derived units
statement: Let A and B be finite commutative rings in Type (u+1), let φ:A→B be a ring homomorphism, and let f:X→Y be a morphism of schemes in universe u. Write Q_A and Q_B for fixed-scalar direct image, V_X and V_Y for exact scalar restriction, and t:V_X RQ_A≅RQ_B V_Y for fixedScalarRestrictionDirectImage [lem-weil-proetale-direct-image-restriction-of-scalars]. For every unbounded B-complex K on X, V_Y(η_QB(K)); t.inv(QK); RQ_A(ε_VX(K)) equals ε_VY(Q_B K); Q(the ordinary restriction/direct-image square on K); η_QA(V_X K), where η denotes the canonical complex-level right-derived unit and ε denotes the exact derived localization factor [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization]. No K-injectivity, flatness, or boundedness hypothesis is needed.

proof.text: The canonical quotient-comparison isomorphisms between the complex and homotopy localizations have identity components. Expanding rightDerivedFunctorUnitQ and cancelling the mapped identities identifies it with rightDerivedFunctorUnit evaluated at the homotopy quotient of the complex.

Apply fixedScalarRestrictionDirectImageMap_factors. Replace the actual mate by the inverse comparison using fixedScalarRestrictionDirectImage_inv, and replace its two homotopy units by the complex-level units from Step 1. The resulting equality is the claimed normalization for every complex. Zero rings and zero complexes satisfy the same functorial identities.

theorem fixedScalarRestrictionDirectImage_unitQ_factors
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (K : CochainComplex
      (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B)) ℤ) :
    (Sheaf.restrictScalars (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) φ).mapDerivedCategory.map
        ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) f).rightDerivedFunctorUnitQ K) ≫
      (fixedScalarRestrictionDirectImage φ f).inv.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) ≫
      (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).rightDerivedFunctor.map
        ((Sheaf.restrictScalars (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) φ).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app K) =
    (Sheaf.restrictScalars (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) φ).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
          (((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex
        (fixedScalarRestrictionDirectImageUnderived φ f).hom (.up ℤ)).app K) ≫
      (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).rightDerivedFunctorUnitQ
        ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
          (Sheaf.restrictScalars (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) φ) (.up ℤ)).obj K)
